name: Heal Beam
notes: Continuous beam locked onto one ally. Overheats after sustained use and cannot heal the user.

name: Heal Ball
notes: Placed or thrown emitter that heals the user and allies inside its radius. Ramps up while a target stays attached.

name: H+ Infuser
notes: Hitscan shots that heal an ally on contact. Cannot damage enemies and cannot heal the user.

name: Heal Canister
notes: Arena pickup. Heals on direct hit then leaves a healing zone. Shipped in 6.6.0 as "Healing Canister"; the wiki files it as "Healing Barrel".
